backend_constraint: Self-hosted Lightpanda and proven Go HTTP/API only
contracts: Opt-in whole-catalogue Go authority with explicit existing epoch and installed source
No active mixed SQL/Redis ownership or B0 guard adoption
Whole enabled canonical/cache catalogue verification before readiness
New-board execution through existing opaque token, SQL, configuration and lease fences
Detail-only simple/browser claims preserve monitor capacity and atomic fairness
Canonical registry eligibility before commit or queue publication
Native publication rejection rolls back prior board disable and invalid board insertion
